_comment: Copy this file to openrouter_config.json and paste your free key. Get one at https://openrouter.ai/keys . The app also writes this file automatically when you click 'Get Suggestions'. Alternatively set the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable instead of storing the key here. 'model' must be a free model id (ends with ':free') - use the 'Load free models' button in the AI dialog to see the current list.
